unit.title: Verb Tenses and a Day in Your Life

contentBlocks.text: ਤੁਸੀਂ ਤਿੰਨ ਕਾਲ ਸਿੱਖੇ। ਅੱਜ ਰੋਜ਼ਾਨਾ ਜ਼ਿੰਦਗੀ ਦੇ ਸ਼ਬਦ! (You've learned three tenses. Today, daily-life words!)

Learn 3 new daily-life words: ਉੱਠਿਆ/ਉੱਠੀ (woke up, past tense), ਸਵੇਰ (morning), and ਰੋਜ਼ (every day/daily). Combine them with tenses you already know: 'ਮੈਂ ਸਵੇਰੇ ਉੱਠਿਆ' (I woke up in the morning, past tense). Write your own sentence about when you woke up today, using ਉੱਠਿਆ/ਉੱਠੀ and ਸਵੇਰ.
ਤੁਸੀਂ ਰੋਜ਼ਾਨਾ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਸਿੱਖੇ! (You just learned daily-life words!) Tomorrow we'll write about a whole day using all three tenses.

objectives: Learn 3 new daily-life vocabulary words: ਉੱਠਿਆ/ਉੱਠੀ, ਸਵੇਰ, ਰੋਜ਼
Combine daily-life vocabulary with past tense in an original sentence
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review this week's tense work.
2. Introduce the 3 new daily-life words.
3. Have the child write a sentence about waking up today.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's full-day-writing lesson.
differentiationTips: Struggling: model the example sentence together before asking the child to write their own version
Ready for more: ask the child to add ਰੋਜ਼ (every day) to their sentence to describe a daily routine, not just today
This lesson directly addresses the course's 'daily life' cultural-units description, connecting new vocabulary to this week's grammar focus
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is an open-ended writing activity — check that the child's sentence correctly uses ਉੱਠਿਆ/ਉੱਠੀ (matching their own gender) and ਸਵੇਰ together.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses the course's 'daily life' cultural-units description, applying this week's tense work to genuinely relevant vocabulary.
